stem: What is biodiversity? Write any four steps to conserve biodiversity.
solution: Biodiversity: Biodiversity is the variety and variability among all the living organisms — plants, animals and microorganisms — present in a particular region or ecosystem, including the diversity of genes, species and ecosystems. Four steps to conserve biodiversity: (1) In-situ conservation — protecting organisms in their natural habitats by setting up national parks, wildlife sanctuaries and biosphere reserves. (2) Ex-situ conservation — protecting them outside their habitat in zoos, botanical gardens, seed banks and gene banks. (3) Preventing deforestation and habitat destruction and promoting afforestation. (4) Imposing a strict ban on poaching and illegal trade of wild plants and animals and creating public awareness about conservation. (Also: controlling pollution and preventing over-exploitation of natural resources.)

stem: What is stem cell? Write any four uses of stem cell.
solution: Stem cell: Stem cells are unspecialised (undifferentiated) cells of the body that have the ability to divide repeatedly and to differentiate into various specialised types of cells and tissues. Four uses of stem cells: (1) In regenerative medicine / stem-cell therapy to repair or replace damaged tissues and organs. (2) In the treatment of blood disorders through bone-marrow transplantation, e.g. leukaemia (blood cancer) and thalassaemia. (3) For growing tissues and organs in the laboratory for transplantation and for treating burns by skin grafting. (4) In the treatment of degenerative diseases such as diabetes, Parkinson's disease, paralysis and spinal-cord injuries, and in research on drug testing and disease study.
